blocks.text: An applicant with a history of thromboembolic disease must submit the following if consideration for medical certification is desired:
blocks.html: An applicant with a history of thromboembolic disease must submit the following if consideration for medical certification is desired:

• Detailed family history of thromboembolic disease;
  • Neoplastic workup, if clinically indicated;
  • Blood clotting disorders (e.g., PT/PTT, Protein S & C, Factor V Leiden); AND
  • If still anticoagulated with warfarin (Jantoven), submit all (no less than monthly) INRs from time of hospital discharge to present

blocks.text: Warfarin (Jantoven): For applicants who are just beginning warfarin (Jantoven) treatment the following is required:
blocks.html: Warfarin (Jantoven): For applicants who are just beginning warfarin (Jantoven) treatment the following is required:

• Minimum observation time of 6 weeks after initiation of warfarin therapy;
  • Must also meet any required observation time for the underlying condition; AND
  • 6 INRs, no more frequently than 1 per week

blocks.text: NOAC/DOACs: For applicants who are just beginning treatment the following is required:
blocks.html: NOAC/DOACs: For applicants who are just beginning treatment the following is required:

blocks.text:
- Minimum observation time of 2 weeks after initiation of therapy; AND
- Must also meet any required observation time for the underlying condition.
